purpose: エリア画面の連続シーン背景。3ホットスポット（①照合デスク ~22%左, ②保存作業室 ~55%, ③デジタル化スタジオ ~80%）
scene: The backyard of a warm town library as one continuous miniature clay diorama, left to right: a local-history reference desk where a tiny librarian compares an old sepia photograph against a big unfolded old map under a desk lamp; a conservation workroom with white gloves, a soft brush, acid-free boxes and a flat table holding fragile papers; a small digitization studio with a large flatbed scanner, a color chart card and a monitor showing a thumbnail grid. Tall bookshelves in the background connect all three areas. Cozy evening light through a round window, handcrafted clay look, tiny figures, quiet mystery mood.
composition: Wide horizontal interior, slight high angle, one continuous room band. Three work areas at roughly 22%/55%/80% width. At least 8% empty margin at both edges. Bookshelf band top 25%, no text on any spine or sign.
required_objects: sepia old photograph on the desk
